ai-review.writing-note: Off by default. Only opted-in providers can be used for writing or planning. Review is configured independently in Security Center; Jev is review-only.
ai-review.vision-capability: The default model supports image recognition
ai-review.jev-note: Jev uses the System One decision API. Its image API is experimental; image recognition must be explicitly enabled here before selecting it for image review.
ai-review.master-note: All AI review switches are off by default. Configure text and image review independently below, then save. Disabling this switch stops both review pipelines.
ai-review.text-enabled: Review submitted text with AI (off by default)
ai-review.image-enabled: Review images with AI (off by default)
ai-review.text-note: Select one or more reviewers (up to 8). Checks posts, comments, polls, user profiles and Space metadata on creation or editing.
ai-review.image-note: Select one or more vision-capable reviewers (up to 8). Checks avatars and uploaded/published images only while enabled. Review copies are resized; animated images must be replaced with static images.
ai-review.no-providers: Configure AI providers in AI settings first. Writing access is not required for review.
ai-review.no-vision: No vision-capable providers. Enable image recognition for the model in AI settings first.
ai-review.text-default: Leave blank for the default policy: allow ordinary notes, discussion and educational content; reject harassment, threats, explicit sexual content, graphic violence, spam and malicious content.
ai-review.image-default: Leave blank for the default policy: allow ordinary photos, art and screenshots; reject explicit sexual content, graphic violence, targeted hateful imagery and obvious spam.
ai-review.decision-note: All selected reviewers must pass. LLMs must return exactly true/false; Jev compliance probability above 0.5 becomes true, otherwise false. Any false rejects the submission. Timeouts, invalid responses and insufficient balance reject the submission and ask the administrator to check the service.
ai-review.no-writing: No AI providers have been opened to the writing assistant by the administrator.
ai-review.rejected: The submission did not pass AI moderation. Please edit it and try again.
ai-review.unavailable: AI moderation failed. Please contact the administrator to check API balance, quota and service status. The submission was not saved.

ai-options.model-note: Enter any model ID supported by your provider. Used for writing when no model override is entered; transcription keeps its own model.
ai-options.reasoning-note: Sent only when selected. Requires a compatible model; higher effort may take longer and use more tokens.
ai-options.azure-note: Use the resource root URL, such as https://example.openai.azure.com. Leave the version empty for Azure OpenAI v1; enter a date to use the legacy deployment API. Uses API Key authentication.
ai-options.header-keep: Leave blank to retain a stored value
ai-options.headers-note: Up to 20 headers, including User-Agent and authentication headers. Values are stored on the server and never returned. Remove a row to delete that header.
ai-options.invalid-headers: Header names must be nonempty and unique.
ai-options.workflow-note: Use one model to plan, then another to write the final text. Providers may be the same. Both stages make an API request and may incur costs.
ai-options.workflow-active: Uses the administrator-configured planning and generation models.

api-error.html-response: The API returned a webpage (HTTP {{status}}, {{path}}). Please retry; if this persists, check the reverse proxy.

blog-extra.preferences-reset: The admin reset everyone's preferences; your display settings are back to the site defaults.

age-notice.text_other: Written {{count}} years ago; some of it may be out of date.

category.editor-description: Create categories and set access permissions. Signed-in users can select one when publishing or editing a memo.
category.empty: No categories yet. Add one to start organizing memos.
category.name: Category name
category.description-placeholder: Briefly describe what this category contains

security.description: Configure anti-spam intervals, automatic moderation thresholds, and database-backed blocked words. Administrator accounts are never automatically banned or quarantined.
security.policy-description: Limit how frequently regular users can publish articles or comments, and configure each automatic action threshold.
security.publish-cooldown-description: How long a regular user must wait after publishing an article or comment; 0 disables the limit.
security.comment-threshold-description: After this many reports, a comment is visible only to administrators.
security.article-threshold-description: After this many reports, an article is visible only to administrators.
security.user-threshold-description: After this many reports, the account is disabled and placed in quarantine.
security.initial-ban-days-description: Defaults to 30 days; the second ban is 60 days, the third is 120 days, and later bans continue doubling.

blocked-words.title: Blocked-word moderation
blocked-words.description: The word list is stored in the database. Manual entry, file upload, and URL import each replace the previous list; it can also be cleared.
blocked-words.empty-error: The word list cannot be empty. Use Clear blocked words to disable it.
blocked-words.replaced: Replaced the list with {{count}} blocked words
blocked-words.file-too-large: The word-list file cannot exceed 30 MiB
blocked-words.file-replaced: Imported the file and replaced the list with {{count}} blocked words
blocked-words.file-import-failed: Failed to import the word-list file
blocked-words.url-replaced: Imported the URL and replaced the list with {{count}} blocked words
blocked-words.status-description: {{source}}. The server checks memos, comments, usernames, nicknames, personal bios, and Space names, descriptions, and URL aliases when created or updated, including SSO signup.
blocked-words.manual-description: Enter one word per line, or separate entries with commas, semicolons, or tabs. Saving replaces the database list instead of appending history.
blocked-words.words-placeholder:
blocked word one
blocked word two
phrase to block
blocked-words.url-description: Only public HTTP/HTTPS text resources are allowed. Private network addresses are rejected and downloads are limited to 30 MiB. A successful import replaces the current list.
blocked-words.file-description: The file is read only in your browser and the server does not retain it. Parsed entries are written directly to the database. Supports UTF-8 TXT and CSV up to 30 MiB.
blocked-words.clear-description: This deletes the current word list and disables blocked-word checks on future submissions and edits, including profiles and Spaces. Existing content is kept.

moderation-center.reports-description: Review article, comment, and user reports in one place. Each user can report the same target only once.
moderation-center.quarantine-description: Automatically quarantined or banned content is visible only to administrators and can be reviewed and restored here.
moderation-center.restored: Restored the item and cleared its report history
moderation-center.adjust-description: Original report records are retained; future valid reports continue from this count.

preference.effects-description: Low power keeps every style's look but stops particles, rain and animated backgrounds. Auto turns it on for slower devices. Saved in this browser.

system.first-visit-description: The language, theme and style a first-time visitor gets. Visitors can change them for themselves.
system.advanced-description: Posts per page, background, festival effects, sign-in rules, custom code, navigation and categories, music, trash and history, appearance packs.
system.more-description: Feed size, background, festival effects and the calendar's first day.
system.accounts-description: How people sign in, what they may change on their profile, and media metadata.
system.default-avatar-description: Upload a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image (up to 10 MiB), or enter an image link. Used for users without an avatar; leave empty for a neutral user icon. Save to apply.
system.default-avatar-uploaded: Image uploaded. Confirm and save settings to apply.
system.default-avatar-invalid-file: Choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image up to 10 MiB.
system.default-avatar-summary: Used for users without a personal avatar. Leave empty for the neutral user icon.

music-admin.default-volume-description: Used until a visitor chooses their own volume. Saving applies it across the site; 0% is silent.

trash.title: Trash
trash.irreversible: This permanently removes the memo, comments, attachments and history. This cannot be undone.
trash.retention-description: Default 30 days. Set 0 to delete immediately without a trash recovery window.

history.title: Version history
history.private: Only memo managers can access history. Old versions may contain information you removed.
history.diff: Compared with the current text: - current lines, + historical lines; at most 1000 lines are shown.
history.restore-description: The current text will be saved before restoring. Normal content checks still apply.
history.remove-description: Deleted history cannot be recovered. The current memo stays unchanged.
history.limit-description: Default 20; maximum 200. Set 0 to stop recording new history. Existing versions can be removed from the history dialog.

backup.title: Site backup
backup.description: Administrator export: all memos, comments and selected attachments in a readable ZIP archive.

void.name: The void
void.lead: Write down what you want to say but not keep. Press Enter and it is gone.
void.label: Something to let go
void.placeholder: Like: honestly, today was a bit much.
void.privacy: Nothing is saved, sent or drafted.
void.count: This browser has let go of {{count}} thoughts.
void.empty: Nothing has been let go here yet.
void.milestone-1: The first one is always the hardest.
void.milestone-50: Fifty. The void says it is not tired; it never keeps anything anyway.
void.milestone-100: A hundred. If you ever want to keep one, Memos is next door.
void.milestone-500: Five hundred. The void counts you as an old friend now.
void.milestone-1000: A thousand. The void awards you an invisible medal.

teapot.name: 418 teapot
teapot.title: I'm a teapot
teapot.lead: This server is a teapot. Under RFC 2324 it may refuse to brew coffee.
teapot.pour: Fine… have a cup of tea. It's hot, careful.
teapot.refusal-1: I'm a teapot. I don't do coffee.
teapot.refusal-2: Really, I'm a teapot. Look at my spout.
teapot.refusal-3: Under RFC 2324, section 2.3.2, I may refuse.
teapot.refusal-4: All I have inside is tea leaves. And a little limescale.
teapot.refusal-5: The coffee machine is next door. It called in sick today.
teapot.refusal-6: I forwarded your request to the coffee machine. It says it doesn't know you.
teapot.refusal-7: Did you know tea has plenty of caffeine too?
teapot.refusal-9: I called my lawyer, a thermos. He says no as well.
teapot.refusal-10: Press once more and I'm putting my lid on.
teapot.refusal-12: Fine, the lid popped off by itself. Still no.
teapot.refusal-13: I wanted to be a coffee machine as a kid. Turns out I make a better teapot.
teapot.refusal-14: You're pressing so earnestly I'm almost touched. Still no.
teapot.refusal-15: Loading coffee… failed: no beans found.
teapot.refusal-16: I'll count to three. One, two… never mind, I can't count, I'm a teapot.
teapot.refusal-17: For the last time: no… wait, are you very tired?

museum.name: Style museum
museum.title: Style museum
museum.lead: Every Memos Plus style, hung in order of its years. Touching the exhibits is allowed: one click puts it on.
museum.locked-note: Golden light shows under the door. They say whoever finds every legendary reaction can push it open.
museum.terminal-materials: Monospace type, green phosphor, one blinking cursor
museum.terminal-note: The first blogs probably looked like this, before anyone called them blogs.
museum.pixel-materials: An 8-bit palette, blocks, hard drop shadows
museum.pixel-note: Every pixel placed by hand, or so it looks.
museum.y2k-materials: #C0C0C0 grey, bevelled push buttons, navy title bars, Tahoma
museum.y2k-note: The Start button still lived in the corner, and the blue screen was not a meme yet.
museum.aero-materials: Glass, bubbles, bright green hills and an always clear sky
museum.aero-note: When technology was going to make the world cleaner.
museum.vaporwave-materials: Pink-violet gradients, sunsets, a grid horizon
museum.vaporwave-note: Nostalgia for a past that never happened.
museum.neumorphism-materials: Raised and pressed surfaces of one colour, soft double shadows
museum.neumorphism-note: Designers loved it briefly, then noticed nobody could find the buttons.
museum.glass-materials: Frosted glass, colour blobs, thin white edges
museum.glass-note: You can see what is behind it; that is the point.
museum.handdrawn-note: The only room in the museum where drawing on the walls is allowed.
museum.default-materials: Clean cards and just enough white space
museum.default-note: What every style looks like with its costume off.
museum.golden-materials: Gold leaf, a halo, a touch of vanity

style-packs.scheme-dark: Drawn for dark themes only: visitors on a light theme see its dark counterpart while the pack shows

blog-import.target-main: Posts will be imported into the main site without a Space.
blog-import.target-space: Posts will be imported into this Space: {{space}}.
blog-import.description: Bring posts over from your old blog: a WordPress export, or a ZIP of Markdown files from Hexo, Hugo, Jekyll and the like. You see a preview first; nothing is imported until you confirm.
blog-import.limit-description: The largest export file anyone may import, 1–250 MiB; 100 by default.
blog-import.formats: WordPress .xml exports, and .zip files of .md files (YAML or TOML front matter welcome). For Typecho and others, export to the WordPress format with a plugin first.
blog-import.source-hint: Use the same name whenever you import from this blog again; posts already imported are then skipped.
blog-import.preview-failed: This file could not be read

blog-import.state-failed: The import stopped on an error; posts already imported stay.

home-today.title: Today
home-today.keep-going: {{count}}-day streak; write today to keep it going

daily-question-admin.title: Daily question
daily-question-admin.description: Manage the question bank and site seed. Changes take effect after saving system settings.
daily-question-admin.enabled-description: Show today's question above the Home composer.
daily-question-admin.seed-description: 1–64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Clear to regenerate when saved.
daily-question-admin.seed-placeholder: Generate a new seed on save
daily-question-admin.default-bank: Built-in bank · Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English
daily-question-admin.language-help: Built-in questions cover every interface language. Custom questions can also have translations, with English as the fallback. New questions default to English; you may also leave their language unspecified.
daily-question-admin.short-schedule: {{count}} questions: {{rounds}} complete shuffled rounds plus {{extra}} questions drawn without replacement, covering 365 days. Every round is shuffled separately.
daily-question-admin.long-schedule: Each year shuffles the bank with the site seed. Up to 365 distinct questions are used; a leap year gets one extra seeded draw.
daily-question-admin.load-failed: Could not load the built-in translations. Close and reopen the bank to retry; existing questions are preserved.
daily-question-admin.bulk-placeholder: One question per line. Blank lines and duplicate questions are skipped.
daily-question-admin.translation-uses-default: This language uses the default question text above.
daily-question-admin.english-fallback: Missing translations fall back to English. Add English here if the default text uses another language. Older questions without English keep their default text.
daily-question-admin.text-limit: Up to 200 characters per language and 2,000 questions total. Keep at least one question, or disable the feature.
daily-question-admin.save-hint: Click Save at the bottom of the system settings page to apply these changes.
daily-question-admin.restore-description: Remove your additions and edits and restore all 365 built-in questions in every interface language. The seed and enabled setting will be preserved; click Save afterwards.
daily-question-admin.error-seed: Invalid seed. Use 1–64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, or clear it to regenerate.
daily-question-admin.error-invalid: Complete every custom question and check its language and translations before saving.
daily-question-admin.error-too-many: The bank can contain at most 2,000 questions.
daily-question-admin.error-too-long: Each question or translation can contain at most 200 characters.
daily-question-admin.error-too-large: The complete question bank cannot exceed 256 KiB.
